      "body": "Hi! Thanks for this great app. Its nice to have a weather aplication which respects the privacy : )\n\nFor me a widget that shows the current and next days weather is the very important since it leaves me to know with only a look how is the weather and how is going to evolve. \n\nOne widget I like is the one from eltiempo.es app. I leave an image with two different widgets as example in case it helps for ideas:\n\n![eltiempo](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/4170088/20339530/257d65a4-abdd-11e6-95d5-0c0bf34f0308.png)\n\nThe upper image its a 4x2 widget. It has info about the current day in the firs row, with the name and number of the day, the maximum and minimum temperatures, the wind direction and velocity, the sunrise and twilight hour, the percentage of clouds and precipitations. In the second row, on the other hand, you can easily see how the weather is going to evolve the next three days with their minimum and maximum temperatures, the wind and the precipitations.\n\nThe second one down its a 4x1 widget instead. Its a simpler possibility that shows the maximum and minimum temperatures of the current day and the next two too.\n"
